description: One ranked row returned by a SemanticSearchRequest. The shape is intentionally minimal so it can be serialized verbatim to the Bedrock agent return-control response without further translation; richer column-level facets continue to live on SearchIndexQuery's results.

rowId.description: The _row_id of the indexed row, matching the row id assigned at index-build time by the SearchIndex's defining SQL. Stable across rebuilds of the same SearchIndex version.

rowVersion.description: The _row_version of the indexed row at the time it was indexed. Useful for callers reconciling hits against the live table.

score.description: The OpenSearch _score for this hit. For HYBRID mode the score has been normalized through the search pipeline so comparisons are meaningful within a single response but not across responses with different modes or different normalization techniques.

fields.description: Map of column name to indexed value for this hit's source fields. Values follow the same Java-side types as SearchIndexQueryResults rows.
